desc:
🦖 **Isla Tacora – Survive the Nights. Call for Help.**

Your boat has just docked on a forgotten island. During the day, you scavenge for supplies. At night, they hunt.

🔦 Explore the dense jungle, abandoned research facility, lighthouse, and shipwreck bay.  
⚡ Restore power, repair the radio antenna, and reactivate all 5 relay towers.  
🚁 Call for rescue, activate the signal lights, and reach the helicopter before it departs.  
🤫 Crouch down and hide in lockers and thick bushes. Don't forget to recharge your flashlight.  
🔫 Craft a stun gun at the workbench. It won't kill dinosaurs, but it might buy you some time.  
❤️ Revive fallen teammates and free those dragged away into the raptor flames.  
🦴 Collect fossils and spend them at the lobby shop.
**They can hear your conversations.**
THE GAME HAVE 3 ENDING and new mode coming soon!
